label: InverterAlarmState
info:
Reads Inverter Alarm State from registers:
- 500: Run state
- 553-554: Warning words
- 555-558: Fault words

Triggers:
1. Periodic: Every 1 minute

Note: Only sends to ThingsBoard if:
- runState != 2 (not normal)
- OR any fault/warning word != 0
- OR activeAlarms array is not empty

name: Route to 3 reads
func:
// Send to all 3 parallel reads
return [msg, msg, msg];

name: Prepare read (RunState 500)
Prepare read (Warnings 553-554)
Prepare read (Faults 555-558)
Build InverterAlarmState JSON
Check if should send
Polls every 1 min, only sends when alarm/fault exists - 3 parallel reads
